name: Sales Report - Detail
query:
SELECT
    dn.name AS 'DO No.:Link/Delivery Note:150',
    DATE_FORMAT(dn.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Date',
    
    -- MODIFIKASI: Ambil langsung field Sales Person (karena pasti cuma 1)
    st.sales_person AS 'Salesman',
    
    dn.customer_name AS 'Customer Name',
    
    -- Invoice Info
    sii.parent AS 'Invoice No:Link/Sales Invoice:150',
    DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Invoice Date',
    
    -- Item Info
    CONCAT_WS(' - ', dni.item_code, dni.item_name, i.brand) AS 'Item Name:Data:250',
    
    dni.qty AS 'Qty:Float:',
    dni.uom AS 'UOM',
    dn.currency AS 'Ccy',
    dni.rate AS 'Price:Currency/ccy:',
    dni.discount_amount AS 'Disc:Currency/ccy:',
    dni.amount AS 'Amount:Currency/ccy:',
    
    -- Tax Calculation (Proporsional)
    (dni.amount / NULLIF(dn.total, 0)) * dn.total_taxes_and_charges AS 'Tax:Currency/ccy:',
    
    -- Total per Item
    dni.amount + ((dni.amount / NULLIF(dn.total, 0)) * dn.total_taxes_and_charges) AS 'Total:Currency/ccy:',
    
    dn.status AS 'Status'
FROM
    `tabDelivery Note` AS dn
JOIN
    `tabDelivery Note Item` AS dni ON dni.parent = dn.name

-- JOIN KEMBALI: Sales Team (Standard Join)
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Team` AS st ON st.parent = dn.name

LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` AS i ON i.name = dni.item_code

-- KUNCI ANTI DUPLIKAT 1: Link ke Invoice via Detail ID
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice Item` AS sii ON sii.dn_detail = dni.name AND sii.docstatus = 1
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice` AS si ON si.name = sii.parent

WHERE
    dn.docstatus = 1
    AND dn.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND dn.is_return = 0

-- KUNCI ANTI DUPLIKAT 2: Grouping per Item Baris
GROUP BY
    dni.name
ORDER BY
    dn.posting_date ASC, dn.name ASC;
report_script:
SELECT
    dn.name AS 'DO No.',
    DATE_FORMAT(dn.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'DO Date',
    st.sales_person AS 'Salesman',
    sii.parent AS 'Invoice No:Link/Sales Invoice:150',
    DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Invoice Date',
    dn.customer_name AS 'Customer Name',
    CONCAT_WS(' / ', dni.item_code, dni.item_name, i.brand) AS 'Item Code / Item Name / Brand:Data:250',
    dni.qty AS 'Qty:Float:',
    dni.uom AS 'UOM',
    dn.currency AS 'Ccy',
    dni.rate AS 'Price:Currency/ccy:',
    dni.discount_amount AS 'Disc:Currency/ccy:',
    dni.amount AS 'Amount:Currency/ccy:',
    dn.status AS 'Status'
FROM
    `tabDelivery Note` AS dn
LEFT JOIN
    `tabDelivery Note Item` AS dni ON dni.parent = dn.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Team` AS st ON st.parent = dn.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` AS i ON i.name = dni.item_code

-- JOIN BARU: Menghubungkan ke Sales Invoice Item berdasarkan No. DO dan Kode Item
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice Item` AS sii ON sii.delivery_note = dn.name AND sii.item_code = dni.item_code
-- JOIN BARU: Menghubungkan ke Header Sales Invoice untuk ambil Tanggal
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice` AS si ON si.name = sii.parent AND si.docstatus = 1

WHERE
    dn.docstatus = 1
    AND dn.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND dn.is_return = 0
ORDER BY
    dn.posting_date ASC;
